After years of loyalty and hundreds of thousands of dollars processed, we are seriously considering taking our business elsewhere.
I would strongly encourage every business owner to research other payment processing companies before choosing Square. Don't assume that years of loyalty or substantial processing volume will result in better treatment, lower fees, or any meaningful appreciation.
Overall, our experience with Square has been absolutely horrible. It feels like a company that is more interested in collecting fees than building lasting relationships with the small businesses that keep it running. Loyalty should go both ways, and unfortunately, that has not been our experience with Square.

reviews.title: Avoid using square at all costs!
reviews.text:
Small business owners pay attention to the fees! Square is becoming a terrible value for small business owners. What started as an affordable, convenient all-in-one business solution has slowly turned into an expensive subscription trap.

They get you invested in their ecosystem, you build your entire operation around their hardware and software, and then they gradually raise prices, eliminate bundled packages, remove features, and turn previously included services into additional monthly expenses.

The biggest problem is that once you’re established on Square, leaving isn’t easy. Your employees are trained on it, your hardware is integrated, your payroll is connected, your customer loyalty program is established, and your entire business depends on the system. Switching providers means disrupting your entire operation.

It feels like Square knows this and uses it to its advantage. Instead of rewarding long-term customers, they continue finding new ways to charge more while offering less.

Small businesses deserve better. We already deal with rising rent, payroll, food costs, and operating expenses. The last thing we need is a software company constantly increasing its prices and dismantling the affordable packages that made us customers in the first place.

reviews.title: Inadequate
reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star

In today’s electronic banking world, taking six days to clear a mobile check deposit is absurd. I don’t know if Square is running the check through the NSA for verification or what, but there is absolutely no reason access to deposited funds should take that long.

To make matters worse, trying to get help is incredibly frustrating because you cannot seem to reach an actual human being for support.

Square Invoices may be convenient for sending invoices, but based on my experience, I would not recommend using their banking services. If you need timely access to your money and responsive customer support, look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed — This Feels Like Bait and Switch
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointed _This Feels Like Bait and Switch

For the second time, I feel Square has pulled the rug out from under hemp-related businesses after allowing us to build our operations around its platform.

Businesses like ours trusted Square with our payment processing, customer database, transaction history, marketing programs, subscriptions, and other critical parts of our day-to-day operations. Square benefited from our processing fees and business for years, but when policies change, there seems to be very little consideration for the businesses that relied on the platform.

Now the burden is suddenly placed on us to download and preserve our own customer information, transaction history, marketing subscriber data, and other important business records before access is affected or lost.

That is what bothers me most. Square encourages businesses to build an entire ecosystem on its platform, but apparently that relationship can change very quickly when Square decides it no longer wants to support a particular industry.

Hemp businesses are legitimate businesses with employees, customers, rent, inventory, taxes, vendors, and years of customer relationships. We deserve reasonable notice, transparency, and a responsible transition process — not to simply be treated as expendable after Square has profited from our transactions.

This is the second time I have experienced this type of treatment from Square, and it has seriously damaged my trust in the company.

reviews.text:
The software? Great. The options and benefits of Square, great? The hoops and inconveniences you have to jump through for a ‘free’ service? Not great. After days of submitting supporting documentation, bank statements, my customers contact information, material from my business and explanations, I was approved by Square’s internal review. Thank goodness after the time I invested to successfully prove them that I wasn’t some third world country fraud scheme…only to try to use the software once more and receive notification my account was being closed. 
Just save your time and effort and go elsewhere. My experience with Square has been so disappointing.
